body:
[A10] Residue of #162, filed on the maintainer decision of 2026-09-07 to close that ledger

## Objective and evidence

Make the compiled census resolve values instead of matching printed literals: link the firmware object at its real base and read relocations, or decode `lui`/`addi`/`slli`/`ori` into the register values the stores use, so that "which functions form a CSR address" is answered by value and the three restored text sets (pointer casts, pointer stores, inline asm) and their ordered-list comparison can be retired with accepted cases measured GREEN.

- #162's body (last table row) states the acceptance question: which functions form a CSR address has to be asked of something that resolves values, not of something that matches printed literals. The [A1] comments of 2026-08-20 on #162 name the shape (link at the real base and read relocations rather than decoding address arithmetic by hand) and the two escapes it must close, both through a paged base at the end of `configure_fabric()`; the [A0] reopening comment of 2026-09-02 keeps "the census's value-resolving upgrade" as the ledger, and PR #322 (merged 2026-09-02, ec7f6862) names it in its Known limitations.
- `docs/integration/BAREMETAL_FIRMWARE.md` at dev 7fd04d45, lines 302 to 321: the census sees a materialised window address and rejects the literal spelling, and does not see the same store through a base held in a variable because no window immediate is printed (lines 307 to 312); the #153 resolver (PR #241, merged 2026-08-25, e69bf4b5) rejects both by computing the address, and the census remains blind to a store planted inside the address helper by construction (lines 318 to 321). Line 563 states the cost: a fifth pointer cast, a fifth pointer store or a third `asm` statement is refused because the census does not cover all three, and two mutants stay reason-pinned on the cast set for that reason. Line 583: reordering existing functions is refused because the cast and store sets are compared as ordered lists. Lines 586 and 587 (factoring the accessors, hoisting the enable mask) are the same cost one step out.
- `sw/builder/test_builder.py`: `assert_csr_store_closure` (line 2716), `pointer_stores` (2888), `assert_store_set_is_closed` (2915), `assert_asm_set_is_closed` (2949, with the comment at 5422 to 5425 that a `lui`-based template carries no window immediate), `census_take` (3457), `assert_compiled_census_is_clean` (3526), and the resolver's store step `_rv32_step_store` (1359) and `rv32_address_taken` (1600). The gate print at lines 8774 to 8778 records that round nine deleted the three sets on the claim the census subsumed them, three shapes went GREEN, and they were restored.

## Authority and scope

- #162 (body and the 2026-08-20 comments); #153 and PR #241 (the resolver and its classification, doc lines 323 to 345); PR #212 (the census compiler proven RV32, merged 2026-08-22); PR #322 (the restoration); `docs/integration/BAREMETAL_FIRMWARE.md` lines 286 to 345 and 552 to 598.
- Context: `sw/builder/test_builder.py` `test_baremetal_profile_contract()` (1903), the census functions above, the RV32 resolver; the LiteX link base the firmware ships at.
- In scope: one value-resolving census (linked object plus relocations, or the resolver's lattice extended to address formation in every function, the address helper included) that answers the two doc escapes and the helper-planted store by its own resolved-value message; the retirement of the cast, store and asm ordered sets, or a recorded reason an inline-asm store cannot be resolved and its cost restated; every mutation those sets pinned re-pinned on the new census; the doc table and the gate print updated.
- Out of scope: the CFG and dataflow properties (#153, closed); the preprocessor and include instruments and the Makefile walker (the two sibling residue issues); the choke-point rules at doc lines 573 to 578.

## Acceptance and validation

1. The two stores at doc lines 307 to 312 and the store planted inside the address helper (doc line 563) are each refused by the census's own resolved-value message, naming the function and the resolved address, with no cast-set or store-set rule active on that arm; a store whose resolved address is outside the window is measured GREEN.
2. Reordering two existing functions with nothing added or removed is measured GREEN and the row at doc line 583 leaves the table with that accepted case; a fifth pointer cast and a fifth pointer store that resolve outside the window are measured GREEN and line 563 is restated to what survives.
3. The inline-asm set is retired with a `lui`-based template that stores into the window refused by value, or kept with the reason it cannot be resolved recorded at the site and in the table.
4. No reduction: every mutation the three sets pinned is re-pinned on the census, the two mutants reason-pinned on the cast set today move to the census's message, the count is not below 163, and `python3 sw/builder/test_builder.py` exits 0 with the census live on a host carrying an RV32 gcc; the stand-down when no RV32 compiler is present still names the arm.
5. `docs/integration/BAREMETAL_FIRMWARE.md` lines 302 to 321 and the cost table, and the gate print (lines 8774 to 8823), match what runs; `python3 -B scripts/docs_check.py` and `python3 scripts/check_baremetal_only.py --check` pass.

## Lane and review

Executor: unassigned. Independent reviewer: unassigned. Assigned by the manager when the lane opens.

Dependencies: none open. Lane conflicts: any branch editing `sw/builder/test_builder.py` gate 1b or `docs/integration/BAREMETAL_FIRMWARE.md`, and the two sibling #162 residue issues; serialise the three.
title: [Boot gate] The compiled census resolves store addresses instead of matching printed immediates
